column1: # PROJECT TEMPLATE CATALOG
# One template per line:  <url> <TAB> <tool> <TAB> <version> <TAB> <description>
#   url         anything copier or ccds accepts (gh: shorthand or full git URL).
#               A cruft row needs the full https:// address: cruft hands the
#               string to git, which does not know the gh: shorthand (measured:
#               "Could not resolve hostname gh:").
#   tool        copier | cruft | ccds   (dispatches to the matching gmake target)
#   version     optional pinned ref/tag (e.g. v1); leave empty for the default
#   description shown in the `fnew` interactive picker
# An entry belongs here when a CHECKABLE FACT justifies it - the project is
# maintained, its owner answers for it, its CI creates and tests a real
# project - and not by a hunch. Write that fact in the description, so the
# next reader knows why the line is there. A starting point, not a ranking:
# a short list that means something beats a long one nobody verified.
# Nothing here suits you? You do not need an entry to use a template:
#   fnew gh:owner/repo [copier|cruft|ccds]      # reads and writes nothing
# and if it earns its place, append a line below - TABs, not spaces, or the
# picker ignores the row (it says so on stderr when it does).
